links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated pediatric cardiothoracic patient pamphlets across six readability metrics
links.effect: Readability differed by model; Gemini was most comprehensible, ChatGPT 4 and Perplexity AI had similar readability; authors conclude readability should be optimized for general public comprehension. No numeric grade levels in abstract.
links.quote: Readability analysis indicated that Gemini produced the most comprehensible content.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of 5 commercial LLMs generating patient educational pamphlets for pediatric cardiothoracic procedures, assessed by expert reviewers and patient advocates for accuracy, readability, consistency, and relevance.
